deadline.value: Recommended deadline for Fall graduate assistantship consideration is February 1.
deadline.quote: The recommended deadline for fall semester graduate assistantship consideration is Feb. 1, although departments/programs may have earlier deadlines.

gre_general.value: A GRE score of 302 or above (verbal and quantitative) is required.
gre_general.quote: A GRE score of 302 or above (verbal and quantitative).

toefl_min.value: A TOEFL score of at least 80 (internet based) is required.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL score of at least 213 (computer-based) or 80 (internet based). This requirement is waived for applicants whose native language is English

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A member of the faculty must agree to serve as the Major Adviser to the prospective student.
supervisor.quote: A member of the faculty who is eligible (graduate status of group III or higher) must agree to serve as the Major Adviser to the prospective student

funding.value: Graduate assistantships include a monthly stipend and tuition coverage, awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Graduate Assistant Positions: All graduate assistants receive a monthly stipend, and | most cover the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: Students with a B.S. or M.S. degree in engineering or engineering equivalent are eligible to apply.
entry_route.quote: Engineering Academic Background: Students with a B.S. or M.S. degree in engineering or engineering equivalent are eligible to apply for the Ph.D. program.
